profile.name: doValue S.p.A.
profile.summary: doValue S.p.A. engages in the management of non-performing loans (NLP), unlikely to pay (UTP), early arrears, and performing loans for banks and investors in Italy, Spain, Greece, and Cyprus. The company offers NPL servicing, including administration, management, and recovery of loans utilizing in court and out-of-court recovery processes for and on behalf of third parties for portfolios consisting in non-performing loans; and real estate servicing, such as real estate collateral management, real estate development, and property management services. It also provides administration, management, and restructuring of loans classified as unlikely-to-pay, on behalf of third parties, with the aim of returning them to performing status; and management of performing loans or loans past due by less than 90 days, not yet classified as non-performing, on behalf of third parties. In addition, it offers services for the collection and organization of information in data room environments and advisory services for the analysis and assessment of loan portfolios for the preparation of business plans for collection and recovery activities; administrative, accounting, cash management, and reporting services in support of the securitization of loans; structuring services for securitization transactions; alternative asset management services that focus on managing third-party funds for investment in NPE portfolios, direct lending opportunities, managing of real estate assets and other asset classes; management of legal proceedings at various levels in relation to loans; sell side and buy side advisory services to support transactions on loan portfolios; and co-investment activities consisting in participating in loan securitizations with clients to obtain service level agreement, as well as mortgage brokerage services. The company was formerly known as doBank S.p.A. and changed its name to doValue S.p.A. in June 2019. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Verona, Italy.
profile.summary_fr: doValue S.p.A. s’engage dans la gestion de prêts non performants (NLP), peu susceptibles de payer (UTP), d’arriérés anticipés et de prêts performants pour les banques et les investisseurs en Italie, en Espagne, en Grèce et à Chypre. La société offre des services NPL, y compris l'administration, la gestion et le recouvrement de prêts en utilisant des processus de recouvrement devant les tribunaux et à l'amiable pour et pour le compte de tiers pour des portefeuilles comprenant des prêts non performants; et des services immobiliers, tels que la gestion des garanties immobilières, le développement immobilier et les services de gestion immobilière. Elle assure également l'administration, la gestion et la restructuration des prêts considérés comme peu probables à payer, pour le compte de tiers, dans le but de les remettre à l'état d'exécution; et la gestion des prêts productifs ou des prêts en souffrance de moins de 90 jours, non encore classés comme non productifs, pour le compte de tiers.
